item.title: FRONTIER CRUCIBLE Star Thomas Jane Explains Why He Was "Miscast" As Frank Castle In THE PUNISHER (Exclusive)
item.description: In 2004, Thomas Jane brought Frank Castle to the big screen in The Punisher. When we asked if he'd be open to reprising the role, the Frontier Crucible star explains why he believes he was "miscast."

item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash has hit tracking boards, and while it's likely to be a box office hit by the end of its run, the threequel is currently expected to land somewhere between Avatar and The Way of Water.

item.title: How Does George Lucas REALLY Feel About Disney's STAR WARS? Here's Everything He's Said About The Sequels
item.description: Star Wars creator George Lucas has remained hands-off with the franchise since selling Lucasfilm to Disney in 2012, but how does the legendary filmmaker really feel about this Galaxy's continued evolution?
